text:
devon: Heads up — merged PR 4567 into main ~2m ago, CI turned red immediately. Failing step: `serve-smoke-alloc` (gpu shard alloc). Build: https://ci.company/842
ci-bot: Build #842 failed · stage=serve-smoke-alloc · task=allocator_init · error=failed to reserve shard (errno=16) · logs: https://ci.company/logs/842/serve-smoke-alloc
alana: who owns the smoke allocator job atm? @sara any idea? :eyes:
sara: I was running a few local jobs earlier but not touching this pipeline. Can look in ~25m (in standup). If it's errno=16 that sounds like the allocator couldn't get a device — possible kernel/driver interaction or a fallback regression.
oncall: I'm oncall — will kick a rerun to rule out flake. Queueing now.
ci-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.company/rerun/842/1 (triggered by oncall).
ci-bot: Rerun #1 started...
oncall: quick note — this was a small test change in PR 4567 (test-timeout tweak). devon, can you paste the commit sha?
devon: sha=def45678 commit title: tighten test timeout for rpc-chunking. Diff small, but could change timing/ordering.
devon: failing log snippet:
```
2026-07-22T18:14:33Z allocator: reserve_shard failed: errno=16
  node=serve-12 shard=3 requested=4096MB available=0MB
  stack: runtime/allocator.go:223 allocReserve
```
ci-bot: Rerun #1 finished — failed (same allocator error).
sara: thanks. repeated failure suggests determinism. Can someone bisect the last 8 commits that touched scheduler/allocator? I can take it after standup, but will be ~30-45m.
alana: if bisect won't start soon, we should consider a quick rollback of PR 4567 to restore main. Agree? :thinking_face:
devon: I can hold off on other merges but can't revert from phone. If @sara can't get to it, +1 on revert.
oncall: tagging infra-rotation: can any infra person help run `git bisect` across the CI runner job? I can attach a minimal repro job if needed.
sara: ok planning: I'll start bisect when I'm free. Steps: 1) reproduce failure locally with small shard request (if possible); 2) narrow commits on scheduler/allocator; 3) open hotfix revert if bisect points to PR 4567. If someone wants to kick a deeper diagnostic in the meantime, go for it.
alana: note to self — post links to flaky-monitoring alert and add a regression tag.
devon: thanks all. leaving logs and build links in the PR thread. If it helps, here are the last-green/first-bad shas: last-green=abc12345 first-bad=def45678
sara: ack — will update thread when I have next step. If I can't find a culprit in 45m we revert.
oncall: adding :hourglass: rerun-forensics in case anyone else gets free cycles.
